note: Names, descriptions and grades follow the list PlayStation and Xbox show since launch, as collected by PSNProfiles and TrueAchievements and cross-checked across the guides below. Five hidden trophies still have cryptic descriptions; their guides say so honestly instead of inventing a method.

trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are yours. There is no separate task: follow the roadmap, finish the story, clean up the 100% checklist, and this is the last one to unlock. All 55 are offline and one playthrough is enough.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: The longest grind in the game and the reason the platinum takes around 200 hours. The 100% checklist appears after the story under Progress > Stats. It asks for far more than the individual trophies do — 70 of the 80 challenges, every robbery, every underwater discovery, every shooting range, drone race and Bret quest — so most other trophies fall out of it naturally. Work through the checklist county by county instead of chasing one category at a time.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida count: jumps, under-bridge flights, Knife Flights and base jumps. Stunts are marked on the map once you find them, and the 100% checklist needs even more stunt work than this, so treat it as a checkpoint on the way to A Long Road rather than a separate grind. Fast bikes and planes make the flight stunts far easier than cars.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Play one round of each of the nine activity types: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. You do not need to win or score well — just start each one. Knock this out early in free roam and it also unlocks several activity locations you will return to for other trophies.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold in all 42 challenges across the 12 shooting ranges. This is widely rated one of the hardest trophies after the 100% grind. Practice with the same weapon class at one range until the timing clicks, then move on — the skills transfer. The 100% checklist also needs shooting-range work, so this pairs with A Long Road.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Learn each course's corners before racing for the win — a slow first lap to memorise the gates beats crashing at full speed. Drone races also count toward the 100% checklist, so tick them off during the post-story cleanup.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same one twenty times. Races are spread across Leonida's counties, so this doubles as a tour of the map. Use the fastest car you own for each surface and keep an eye out for shortcuts; the race series also feeds the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Challenge Cal to a fishing contest and out-fish him. Match your lure to the fish the challenge asks for and watch the tension meter — reeling too hard snaps the line. Fishing is also one of the nine activity types for Master of None, and the fishing challenges feed the 80-challenge list for One Last Thing.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish any arcade game at an arcade cabinet. Pick the shortest game on the machine and play it through to the end screen — no high score needed. Arcades are also a good place to try the video-game activity type for Master of None.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight full Strangers & Freaks mission strands. Each strand is a chain of missions for one character — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret among them — and each chain ends with its own bronze trophy too. Stranger missions appear as question marks on the map; some are Lucia-only (Andy) and some are Jason-only (Tyrone and Bret), so switch characters when a strand stalls. After the story ends, every quest giver tied to a trophy comes back, so nothing here is missable.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONLY TROPHY FLAGGED AS POSSIBLY MISSABLE. Meditate at all 18 meditation spots. The first spot, at Jason's house, can only be used in Chapter 1, and it is not yet clear whether that one counts toward the 18 — meditate there in Chapter 1 anyway to be safe. The last spot cannot be reached until you can play as both characters, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Work through the spots as you explore each county and check them off here as you go.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret's strand is Jason-only. Follow his hunting missions until he asks you to take down a unique animal, then track it with the hunting scope and take a clean shot. Unique animals are marked once you are on the right trail — do not rush the stalk or the animal spooks. Finishing Bret's whole strand also counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Finish any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — in shops, on tables and in out-of-the-way spots — and the WAiNK app helps you log the ones you have found. The 100% checklist wants more cards than this trophy does, so keep collecting past three sets; the exploration challenge that asks for 3 cards in each county is a good route to follow.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan 100 spots with the WAiNK app: landmarks, curiosities and sculptures. Open WAiNK whenever you arrive somewhere new and scan everything that glows — the count climbs fast in Vice City itself. Scanning also feeds the encyclopedia challenge (discover 100 animals, vehicles and weapons) and the 100% checklist, so make it a habit from the first hour.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Finish any 50 of the 80 challenges, in eight groups of ten: Combat, Crime, Exploration, Fitness, Shopping, Sports, Survival and Vehicles. Most come naturally while you chase other trophies — mugging, stick-ups, WAiNK scans and races all count. The 100% checklist needs 70, so this trophy is a milestone on the way, not the finish line. Check the progress menu to see which groups are closest to done.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. The easiest escape players report is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County: officers struggle to follow along the tracks and the helicopter loses sight of you. Stay in the tunnel until the stars clear, then drive out calmly.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level between them. Plan a route of three close shops, hit them fast, and keep moving — the wanted level must stay active the whole time. A fast getaway car parked outside each shop helps more than a bigger gun.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — a WAiNK scan is enough, you do not need to drive or own them. Scan every new vehicle you see on the road, in traffic and parked. The vehicle-discovery challenges (examine 6, then more) and the encyclopedia challenge stack with this one, so scan liberally from the start of the game.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop five enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Before the fight, buff your focus with food, drinks or a shower at home, bring Adrenaline, and use an assault rifle for the extra range and damage. Pick a fight with a big group — gang hideouts and police ambushes give you enough targets in one place.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without ever being detected. Go in quiet: move slowly, stay out of sight lines, and take the goods without tripping an alarm or being spotted by staff. If you are seen, leave and try again — the trophy only counts a fully undetected run.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape each time. Bank vaults are the big set-piece robberies — plan the approach, bring your partner, and have an escape route ready before you go in loud. Each successful vault also feeds the 100% checklist, so this is core progress, not a side quest.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks patrol the highways — block one in, force the doors, grab the cash and get clear before the response arrives. A fast car waiting nearby matters more than firepower; the cops arrive quickly once the alarm goes up.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Visit every region of Leonida until the whole map is uncovered. Drive the highways between counties, stop in every city and town, and ride the train — the rail-tour challenge (a mile of train in each county in one day) is a good excuse to see the far corners. This also feeds the road-trip challenge, which asks you to drive to every city and town in one day.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation run by each gang in Leonida. Gang operations are marked once you find them — hit one per gang, not several from the same crew. These robberies also count toward the 100% checklist, so fold them into the post-story cleanup.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock enemies down with a melee drive-by — attack from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon. The exact condition is still being confirmed by players, so the honest version is: drive past a group on foot, swing from the vehicle, and bowl them over. Check back on the cited guides as the method firms up.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists — pass them to your contacts to clean them, and the total adds up across the whole game. Keep laundering as you earn instead of letting bills pile up, and this lands well before the end of the 100% run.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, food, anything. The shopping challenges stack with this: spend $250 at convenience stores, $1,000 at barbers, $5,000 on clothing, $20,000 in one mod-shop visit, $50,000 at Ammu-Nation and $125,000 at mod shops. Buy gear you actually want and the total takes care of itself.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy every garage property in Leonida. Garages are bought through the in-game property sites and each one gives you storage for the vehicles you collect for Whip It Good. Save up through the story — property prices add up — and buy them during the post-story cleanup when money is plentiful.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Steal or buy a mix of cars and bikes, then register each one through the app — ten different vehicles, not the same one ten times. The carjacking challenges (register or respray stolen vehicles from ten manufacturers) stack nicely with this.
trophies.name: On the Spot

trophies.guide: Story trophy — unlocks automatically when you finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, Jason's first job. It is the first trophy most players earn and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy — unlocks automatically when you finish Chapter 1. Remember to meditate at Jason's house during Chapter 1 for Positive Mental Attitude, the one possibly missable trophy.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy — unlocks automatically when you finish Chapter 2. Trackers censor this name; the full name is shown here as it appears in the game.
trophies.name: Tits Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy — unlocks automatically when you finish Chapter 3.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy — unlocks automatically when you finish Chapter 4.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story trophy — unlocks automatically when you finish the final story mission. One of only two gold trophies in the game, and the last story trophy before the post-game cleanup begins. Once the credits roll, the cheats list unlocks — but cheats disable trophies and saving, so keep them off until the platinum is done.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy — unlocks automatically when you complete the mission Breakfast Run. Missions cannot be replayed, so save manually at the start and end of every chapter.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy — unlocks automatically when you complete the mission The Cartel Heist.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy — unlocks automatically when you complete the mission Child's Play.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy — unlocks automatically when you complete the mission Headliners.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy — unlocks automatically when you complete the mission VCIA Takedown.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy — unlocks automatically when you complete the mission Operation Savage Glory.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's Strangers & Freaks strand. Andy's missions are Lucia-only, so switch to Lucia when his strand stalls. After the story ends, Andy comes back, so the strand cannot be missed. Completing it also counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's Strangers & Freaks strand. Follow his missions to the final one and complete it. After the story ends, Kenton comes back, so the strand cannot be missed. Completing it also counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's Strangers & Freaks strand. Follow his missions to the final one and complete it. After the story ends, Billy comes back, so the strand cannot be missed. Completing it also counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's Strangers & Freaks strand. Follow his missions to the final one and complete it. After the story ends, Randy comes back, so the strand cannot be missed. Completing it also counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's Strangers & Freaks strand. Tyrone's missions are Jason-only, so switch to Jason when his strand stalls. After the story ends, Tyrone comes back, so the strand cannot be missed. Completing it also counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Hidden trophy with a cryptic description. The honest read: at Vice City International Airport, leave in a way the airport did not schedule — players are still confirming the exact trigger. Do not chase this one until the cited guides confirm a method; it will likely pop during normal airport chaos.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Hidden trophy with a cryptic description. The honest read: it involves the Rhino tank — players are still confirming whether it asks you to drive one, survive in one, or cause chaos with one. Check the cited guides for the confirmed method before grinding it.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Hidden trophy. Go to Ocean Beach, find a spot with a view, and enjoy a cocktail there. This one is a quiet moment rather than a challenge — sit, drink, and let the trophy pop. It is one of the five hidden trophies whose conditions were still being confirmed at launch.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Hidden trophy. Drive a car through a vehicle showroom's glass and out the other side, in classic GTA style. Pick a showroom with a clear exit path, build speed, and smash through — the trophy is about the spectacle, not precision.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Hidden trophy. Go bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through — finish a full game there. Bowling is also one of the sports activities, so this pairs with the sports challenges.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Hidden trophy with a cryptic description. The honest read: it involves a partnership that draws a crowd — players are still confirming the exact trigger. Check the cited guides for the confirmed method rather than guessing.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Hidden trophy with a cryptic description. The honest read: it pops after a story choice with real consequences — it will come naturally on a normal playthrough. There is no separate grind for it; just play the story and make your choices.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Hidden trophy with a cryptic description. The honest read: something that fails the first time works the second — players are still confirming what exactly. It is one of the five hidden trophies whose conditions were still unsolved at launch, so check the cited guides before chasing it.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Hidden trophy with a cryptic description. The honest read: it pops after something strange and unexpected happens in Leonida — the kind of moment you will know when you see it. It is one of the five hidden trophies whose conditions were still unsolved at launch, so check the cited guides for the confirmed trigger.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
